deny.english-code: code must be in English only: identifiers, comments, and logs. Test files are excluded: test names and test data can use the language of the project. Put user-facing text in the translation file (lang/, locales/, i18n/) and use the key through the i18n of the stack. See craft:english-code. For user-facing text, load craft:i18n for the pattern of each stack.
deny.test-id: every interactive element of a component needs data-testid: button, a, input, select, textarea, form, and every element with a click, submit, change, or input handler. Use a business name in kebab-case (profile-save-button). In a repeated item, use the business id (item-card-${item.sku}), never the position. A wrapper that forwards the attributes of the parent (v-bind="$attrs" in Vue, {...rest} in React) passes. See craft:test-ids.
deny.test-skip: do not skip, focus, or disable a test (.skip, .only, .todo, xit, fit, markTestSkipped, t.Skip, #[ignore], @Disabled). A red test shows what the code lacks: fix the code. If the specification changed, change the test together with it. See craft:atdd.
deny.e2e-container: an E2E test runs only in a container, never on the host. Run it with the e2e service of the compose file: docker compose run --rm e2e <command>. If the project has no e2e service yet, create it with the official image of the runner at the version of the package (mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v<version>-noble, cypress/included:<version>). See craft:e2e-container.
deny.filtered-tests: run only the tests that the change can break, with a filter: the test file or folder, related, --filter, -k, -t, -run. The full suite runs in CI. Without CI, it runs locally only before a push or a PR/MR, with the consent of the user through AskUserQuestion (Run the full suite locally / Continue without the full suite). For the filter of each runner, see craft:filtered-tests.
deny.push-gate: the project has no CI, so no place runs the full suite after the push. Before a push or a PR/MR, ask the user with AskUserQuestion if you must run the full suite locally. Use the exact options Run the full suite locally and Continue without the full suite. If the user chooses to run it, run the suite and push only when it is green. See craft:filtered-tests.
deny.research-first: research before you create infra or pin a version. Find the official guide and the expert practice for the subject (craft:state-of-the-art), and check the version in the registry (craft:verify). Use WebSearch, WebFetch, Context7, or a registry command (npm view, docker manifest inspect). Cite the sources in the reply. Then edit again.
deny.memory-outside-project: memory belongs to the project, in .claude/memory/, inside the repo. Write the file there and add the line to .claude/memory/MEMORY.md. Local memory (~/.claude/projects/) is valid only on this machine and the team cannot see it. See craft:memory.
context.memory-empty: The project has no memory yet. Create .claude/memory/MEMORY.md with the first memory.
context.tasks-reminder: [craft:tasks] Before the first tool call, count the actions in this prompt. Two or more actions, or a new action during work in progress: create one task per action with TaskCreate. Keep one task in_progress. Mark it completed with the result.
context.research-reminder: [craft:state-of-the-art] Before code, config or infra: research the official docs and how experts do it today. Reuse: native first, then a vetted package, then own code. Cite sources.
context.memory-reminder: [craft:memory] Before the turn ends: a correction, a decision or a fact that a future session needs goes to .claude/memory/ now.
context.refactor-on-green: [craft:refactor-on-green] The tests are green. If a scenario of the ATDD loop remains, go back to step 2 with the next one. When all scenarios are green, load craft:craft with the Skill tool and do step 6 (refactor).
context.codebase-map: [craft:codebase-map] What already exists in the project. Reuse it before you write new code. Read a file only when you need its details:
context.memory-truncated: (The catalog is cut here. Read the rest in .claude/memory/MEMORY.md.)
block.meta-verify: [craft:meta-goal] The goal is not closed. Run `{command}` after the last code edit, with a success result. Cite the command and the result in the reply. Then close the goal.
block.meta-close: [craft:meta-goal] Goal met. Mark the META task as completed. End the reply with META CLOSED: met, the verification command, and the result.
